criteria_verification.notes: KeycloakIdentityProvider implements IdentityProvider interface with sync getter currentPrincipal backed by _currentPrincipal field (in-memory cached Principal). Implementation verified at lines 41-54.

_performSignIn() attempts silent refresh first (lines 76-84), falls through to interactive PKCE S256 flow only when unavailable/failed. Test 'a valid stored session refreshes silently' confirms no interactive call when silent succeeds.

_interactiveSignIn() uses _config.redirectUrl and _config.scopes in AuthorizationTokenRequest (lines 113-134). KeycloakConfig.scopes frozen to ['openid', 'offline_access'] per keycloak_config.dart:51. Custom-scheme redirect handled by flutter_appauth.

Two distinct exception types defined: SignInCancelled (lines 20-27) and SignInFailed (lines 29-38). _interactiveSignIn() distinguishes via _isCancelError() (lines 128-141). Test confirms both exceptions thrown correctly, never conflated.

signIn() implements single-flight guard via _signInInFlight field (lines 57-72). Returns existing future if not null. Test 'second concurrent signIn shares one flow' verifies 1 interactive call despite 3 concurrent signIn() calls.

_scheduleProactiveRefresh() schedules Timer for 5 minutes before accessTokenExpirationDateTime (lines 198-213). Called after sign-in (line 172) and after each refresh (line 244). Test 'refreshes before access token expiry' confirms KC-G3 requirement.

signOut() increments _generation counter (line 250). _performBackgroundRefresh() captures generation at start (line 216), checks after async operations (lines 239-242), discards if changed. Test 'wins over in-flight refresh' confirms principal null after sign-out despite completing refresh.

_performBackgroundRefresh() wraps refresh in try-catch (lines 218-236). On exception: sets _currentPrincipal = null, clears store (lines 231-234), never propagates. Test 'unrecoverable refresh clears principal without throwing' confirms graceful degradation.

_currentPrincipal initializes to null (line 48). _performSignIn() checks stored session (lines 76-84), proceeds to interactive if null/expired. Tests 'absent stored session' and 'unreadable stored session' confirm signed-out treatment.

FakeAppAuth (lines 301-392) implements FlutterAppAuth without platform channels. FakeSecureSessionStore (lines 395-428) uses in-memory storage. All tests hermetic - no browser, network, or platform dependencies.
Runtime parity confirms 'flutter analyze' output: 'No issues found! (ran in 1.9s)'. All 325 tests passed. Zero lint errors across entire codebase.
